title: Other Ways to Say "Because" #shorts
description:
Other ways to say "Because" in English – 5 words to use instead.
Don't say "Because". Say this instead:
• Since: Since it's late, let's go home.
• As: As it was raining, we stayed in.
• Due to: The flight was late due to fog.
• Thanks to: Thanks to you, we finished early.
• Seeing as: Seeing as you're here, let's start.

Note: "due to" and "thanks to" replace "because of" – put a noun after them, not a full sentence.

Which one will you try today? Write it in the comments.
